feature_name: Dialog Consolidation and Share Dialog Fix
description: Consolidate duplicate dialog components by removing old template and document dialogs in favor of the new envelope dialogs. Additionally, fix an issue where the share dialog closes automatically when it shouldn't.
functional_requirements: Remove the old template-delete-dialog and template-duplicate-dialog components
Remove the old document-delete-dialog and document-duplicate-dialog components
Update all references in the codebase to use the envelope-delete-dialog and envelope-duplicate-dialog components instead
Fix the share dialog component to prevent it from closing automatically
Update relevant dropdown components to reference the new consolidated dialog components
Update end-to-end tests to reflect the new dialog structure
